question: When does jim propose to pam on the office?
text: Jim proposes to Pam in **“Weight Loss,” the Season 5 premiere of *The Office***, which originally aired on **September 25, 2008**. He proposes in the rain at a gas station. If your streaming service splits the premiere into two parts, the scene is in **Part 2 (Season 5, Episode 2)**. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weight_Loss_%28The_Office%29?utm_source=openai))
